# KKR Construction & Developers

> Premier civil engineering and building construction company based in Thiruvallur & Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Specializing in residential construction, commercial complexes, and advanced Mivan aluminum formwork monolithic casting technology.

## Core Capabilities & Specializations

- **Mivan Formwork Construction**: Rapid cycle times of 7–10 days per floor, monolithic RCC concrete casting (slab, beam, and walls poured simultaneously), zero external plastering required, high earthquake & seismic resistance, mirror-smooth concrete surface finish.
- **Residential Construction**: Turnkey luxury villas, independent houses, multi-story duplexes, architectural planning, 3D structural elevation, and Vaastu-compliant layouts.
- **Commercial Complexes**: Office parks, shopping complexes, IT parks, retail showrooms, RCC framed structures, and heavy load-bearing raft foundations.
- **Structural Engineering & Foundation Works**: Raft foundation, pile foundation, isolated footings, RCC shear walls, structural soil testing, and seismic compliance.
- **Joint Venture (JV) Development**: Transparent land development partnerships for landowners in Thiruvallur, Avadi, Poonamallee, Ambattur, and Western Chennai corridors.
